evidence.rationale: The listing establishes identity well: the VIN decodes to a 1998 Z3 M convertible, consistent with the S52 engine, and an AutoCheck summary reports a clean title, 0 accidents and 5 previous owners. The attached photos show a straight silver car with stock M wheels and body, plus a trunk luggage rack; no underside, trunk-floor, engine-bay or cluster images were examined here. Nothing is observed to be wrong, but nothing about maintenance is documented: there are no cooling-system records, no rear subframe evidence, and no service history across five owners on a Massachusetts car. The $21,986 ask sits in the upper part of the $17,734–$22,877 fair-value band. The car has been listed 529 days at a no-haggle price. The fee language is internally inconsistent ($395 vs $495 doc fee). The two model-critical items that apply, rear structure and cooling history, are both missing; the S54 rod-bearing item does not apply to this S52 car.
